## Highlights
### New
- Site Controls can clear the open site's cookies or its cache. Clearing cookies signs you out of the site and removes everything it stored in that Space, including service workers and what sites embedded in it stored there. Both are also in the command palette and, on iPhone and iPad, the page menu. - Each Space's Privacy settings list the sites that keep data, with Remove and Remove All, and can clear history, cookies and site data, and cached files from the last hour up to all time.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
